query: INSERT INTO model_capabilities (provider_model_id, operation, surface, mode, source, certified_at) SELECT $1, t.operation, t.surface, t.mode, t.source, CASE WHEN t.source = 'certified' THEN now() ELSE NULL END FROM UNNEST($2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[]) AS t(operation, surface, mode, source) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
